department: Science Branch, Directorate of Education (DoE), GNCTD

name.hi: मुख्यमंत्री विज्ञान प्रतिभा परीक्षा छात्रवृत्ति योजना

bilingual_title.hi: मुख्यमंत्री विज्ञान प्रतिभा परीक्षा छात्रवृत्ति योजना

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Class IX student in recognised school (Govt/Aided/Private) in Delhi (NCT); outside Delhi NCT excluded.
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Open merit with category relaxation in qualifying marks
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: Class VIII qualifying marks (typically 60%, relaxation for SC/ST/PH) + MVPP merit.
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: Recognised Delhi school Class IX enrolment.

benefit.summary_hi: एमवीपीपी परीक्षा में चयनित कक्षा 9 के मेधावी विद्यार्थियों को ₹5,000 (ऐतिहासिक दर [अधिसूचना जांचें]) छात्रवृत्ति।
benefit.summary_en: Merit scholarship (historically ₹5,000 for selected Class IX students [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]) based on MVPP exam performance.

verification_note.en: Notice ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): Always verify active 2026–27 window, exact slab/amount, and current circular on the official portal before applying.

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
